title: BC N102: Induction Loop System
officialText:
N102.1 Induction loop system specifications.

1.Where induction-loop systems are provided for hearing aid purposes, the system performance shall be in accordance with IEC 60118-4:2014.

2.The methods of measuring and specifying the performance of system components shall be in accordance with IEC 62489-1:2010, as specified in IEC 60118-4:2014.

3.All electrical wiring installations shall be in accordance with the New York City Electrical Code.

N102.2 Capital projects.

City funded projects shall provide induction-loop systems pursuant to Section 224.3 of the New York City Charter.
